about_the_game:
Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash is  an addictive free-to-play MMO strategy game, you'll build a mighty kingdom, command a fearsome army, and clash with rivals in epic PVP battles.

Prepare for a thrilling adventure where every decision counts. Construct your base, gather resources, and train unique troops to outsmart your opponents in tactical combat. Raid enemy villages for loot, forge alliances with other players, and expand your territory in a quest for ultimate dominance.

Features:

- Build an Unstoppable Force: Construct your base, upgrade buildings, and craft deadly traps.

- Command a Powerful Army: Train and level up your troops and unleash devastating special abilities.

  • Grow your base: Raid rivals, construct in strategic locations, and expand your kingdom.

- Forge Alliances: Join forces with other players to create unstoppable clans.

- Master Tactical Combat: Deploy your army wisely in real-time battles that demand cunning.

- Instant Action: No long wait times - engage in combat whenever you're ready and have food!

- Play PVE Bandits Campaign: Progress over the bandit campaign and gain resources.

- Climb the Ranks: Prove you might and rise to become the ultimate Lord!

A World of Conflict Awaits:

In a realm where kingdoms clash and bandit hordes run rampant, only the strong will survive. Will you rise to the challenge, build a formidable empire, and conquer your enemies?

Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash delivers:

- Thrilling strategic gameplay

- Intense PVP and PVE battles

- Base-building excitement

- Epic loot

- Clans & strategic resource sharing.

Download Bandits vs. Lords: Epic Clash for FREE and claim your destiny today!

In-app purchases are available. A network connection is required.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 128MB Video Card (DirectX 10 capabilities)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 above
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 512MB Video Card (DirectX 10 capabilities)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required
